decoder.name: ugreen-web-login-success
decoder.prematch: insertLog login User \[[^\]]+\] from \[[0-9.]+\] logged in successfully
decoder.regex: insertLog login User \[([^\]]+)\] from \[([0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{1,3}){3})\] logged in successfully

decoder.name: ugreen-web-login-failure
decoder.prematch: insertLog login User \[[^\]]*\] from \[[0-9.]+\] failed to log in due to
decoder.regex: insertLog login User \[[^\]]*\] from \[([0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{1,3}){3})\] failed to log in due to
